comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Facts reach the sidebar, muster window and --json (round of 2026-09-28). Left: a pane wait keyed on a fact, and the app installing or pointing at extras/claude-code; both raised as their own cards.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: amterp asked to see at a glance how full an agent's context is, whether it has sub-agents running, and similar (a_2XMXOShAA). muster-daemon now stores and publishes those facts on each pane's record (Pane.facts: context used %, sub-agents running, model, cost, free-form keys), reported by the agent through muster-daemon report. What remains is the app: the core's mirror holds Pane.facts, the sidebar row renders context and sub-agents without clutter, muster window and its --json show them, and muster pane wait may key on one (e.g. context over 80%). Lands after the cut-over (C12/C13), when the app reads muster-daemon. The app should also ship or point at extras/claude-code/. Note for amterp: his tai-managed statusline needs the report call (extras/claude-code/statusline.sh wraps an existing statusline command).
title: Show agent facts in the sidebar and muster window
